extension.description: Atom activate-power-mode for VS Code: real canvas particles in your syntax colors, screen shake and a combo counter.
config.enabled: Enable Power Mode (injects into the workbench). Requires a window reload after changing.
config.maxParticles: Maximum particles alive at once (performance cap).
config.combo.timeout: Seconds until the combo resets. 0 = never.
config.combo.activationThreshold: Only show particles/shake at or above this combo count (0 = always).
config.combo.exclamations: Show an exclamation (Super!, Radical! ...) every 10 combos.
